description_en: A resource group provides a set of dedicated machine resources for Platform for AI (PAI). These resources run your PAI computing tasks and Data Science Workshop (DSW) instances. This operation retrieves statistics about the current and historical statuses of DSW instances in a specified resource group, such as the number of succeeded, failed, and stopped instances. These statistics help you understand your task history and optimize resource usage
description_zh: 资源组是特定用户。在使用PAI产品前，预先购买的一组机器资源；这些机器资源专属于此客户，不会被其他客户分享。用户后续的PAI计算任务，或算法开发环境，将运行在这组机器上。此功能用于统计在指定资源组上，运行的 DSW 实例（算法开发环境）的当前和历史运行状态（成功，失败，停止等等），以帮助用户了解在资源组内运行任务的历史状态，更有效率的利用资源组内的机器资源
name: GetResourceGroupStatistics

parameters.help_en: The IDs of workspaces. Separate multiple IDs with a comma (,). For more information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID列表，多个ID间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group (machine group)
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID，唯一标识客户的资源组（机器组）
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range for the statistics
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range for the statistics
parameters.name: end_time

schema.description_en: The statistics of the resource group

Code.description_en:
The status code. Valid values:

InternalError: An internal error occurred. All errors other than parameter validation errors are classified as internal errors.

ValidationError: A parameter is invalid
Code.description_zh:
状态码，可能值：

ValidationError：参数验证错误

The HTTP status code. Valid values:

400

additionalProperties.description_en:
Running: 3: Three DSW instances are running.

Stopped: 4: Four DSW instances are stopped

被停止的DSW任务：Stopped：4
